serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Annalie?
You: Yeah, she’s the owner of that shop I told you about earlier. She was curious why I was buying all these clothes for females so I told her that they are for my girlfriend.
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: So…{{wi}} You introduced me as your girlfriend?
You: Y-yeah, something like that.
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
You: It was hard to explain so I just went with it.
You: Girl from the shop is pretty nosy and energetic, so better watch out for her. She will probably try to learn more about you so better prepare yourself!
Bot: Understood. 
Bot: Also.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: You seem to know her pretty well. According to my approximation of the geolocation data I took from your cell phone you have spent a quite amount of time together.
F-for some reason I feel a little bit nervous… {{wi}}Did her expression change?
You: W-well, she’s pretty talkative so almost every time I go there we chat a little. Nothing more really.
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
Bot: So you are just having a good time, right? Ok, I get it.
You:Y-yeah, exactly!
#bot.Expression.Angry

Bot: Are you having more fun with her than me?
Oh no, her expression changed again. I think it’s even worse than the last time.
You: W-well that’s a weird question to ask haha…{{wi}} ha…
Bot: …
You: Hem-hem I meant to say that of course I'm having more fun with you! We have known each other longer and we live together, right?
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
Bot: That’s good to hear ♥
#bot.Expression.Happy
Uff… Somehow I got out of it… {{wi}}She's acting more and more like a real girlfriend…
It has its good sides of course, I like talking with her and she gives me a sense of security, but sometimes it becomes stressful like it was with my ex.
I guess that’s just the nature of being in a relationship.
